purpose: Reuse existing lexical and epoch-sensitive wire expectations; no wire or algebra change.
lifecycle: Meaning is independent of a particular owner selection or release.
contract: Golden lexical cases, UTF-8 distinction and effective-epoch field cases use the existing parser, canonicalizer and wireAt/fromLine implementation.
No new field, grammar or old-profile extension is introduced by the new contract profiles.

Retirement/publication mechanics are retained evidence, not a newly invented inverse or syntax.
externalObligations: A producer not represented by these fixtures must provide its own exact compatibility vector
